sn48.67:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci jambudīpakā rukkhā, jambū tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.67:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhikā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati: yadidaṃ bodhāya.
sn48.67:1.4: saddhindriyaṃ bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiko dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
sn48.67:1.8: paññindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiko dhammo. taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
sn48.67:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci jambudīpakā rukkhā, jambū tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
